stories.headline: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon, its new frontier AI model
Elon Musk is now co-leading America's AI warfare project
SpaceX says Starship will put giant telescopes on the Moon
Figure trained robots to jump into molten steel and filmed it
Gemini now lets you save commands and run them with one tap
Starlink now covers 40 percent of Alaska Airlines entire fleet

caption:
Here's what happened in AI in the last 24 hours, from Google's most powerful model yet to Elon Musk co-leading a military AI project

• Google dropped Gemini 4 Argon today, its most powerful AI yet for coding, enterprise work, and cybersecurity defense, now rolling out to a first wave of trusted testers.
• Elon Musk showed up at today's State of the Force address. War Secretary Pete Hegseth named him co-leader of Project Meridian, the program shaping how the US military fights with AI.
• SpaceX says Starship will carry telescopes large enough to change physics research into orbit, and eventually place even bigger ones on the Moon.
• Figure Robotics trained its F.02 robots to jump on their own, flew them to Finland, and filmed them leaping into molten steel to be melted down.
• Gemini added Skills, type "/" in the prompt bar, pick a saved instruction, and it runs. Set it once, use it every time.
• Starlink now covers over 40% of Alaska Airlines' fleet, including every Hawaiian Airlines long-haul plane and the full regional network.

Figure's robots flew to Finland and jumped into molten steel, and Elon Musk is now officially co-leading the US military's AI program. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Google DeepMind, US Department of Defense, SpaceX, Figure Robotics, Alaska Air Group
